author: nefsik
quote: Open world sounds great, but I play souls game in coop. In Elden Ring coop is the worst of all Souls games. The open world is huge, and you cannot ride your mount in coop. So you can tiptoe through the empty fields. You get invaded repeatedly in coop, as this is the only way invasions even happen. I have no problem with the invasions in the other games. Covenants gave you a reason to invade. In Elden Ring the only reason to invade is to be a jerk. It is just annoying, especially since my son and I died only three times to around 200 invaders. What did we get for all that wasted time? Almost nothing. No rewards. Worst souls game for coop they've ever made.

author: nefsik
quote: I ran into a game breaking bug. I figured, no problem, just put in a ticket. The devs got back to me and said, thanks for reporting the bug. When I asked when they would fix the bug so I could play, they said they had no plans to fix it for me. Horrible customer service, broken game!

author: nefsik
quote: This game has literally everything you could want in a soulslike. Coop is seemless. Fashionsouls at its best. Awesome bosses. Difficult to navigate NPC quests. Hidden and missable paths. Whats more, it also has built in Randomizer for enemies AND items. There is not another soulslike in existence that is this good. If you are a souls fan and haven't played this game, get it now.

author: nefsik
quote: This game should be retitled Grand BossB Dating Simulator. It isn't about Grand Theft. It isn't a traditional sequel to the series. It is rarely fun and never funny while Lucia b's and moans about every little thing and treats you like the tool that the main character is. He has no substance, no choice, basically a walking slave to this horrible woman.
